card.name: Gaps where math symbols were stripped
card.fires_on: Spaces, commas and small linking words like "and" or "as" at spots in math or physics text where a formula or symbol has been removed. The gap sits right after a phrase like "is re-written as" or "mass of the right side is".

modes.label: Blank after 'as' or 'is'
modes.description: A space token where an equation was dropped, right after a phrase that introduces a formula.

modes.label: Comma or 'and' between formulas
modes.description: A comma or 'and' joining two removed symbols or equations in a derivation.

modes.label: 'and' or 'as' around missing variables
modes.description: A linking word standing between variables that were deleted from the text.
